tasks.short: Encourage exploration and perseverance with challenging learning

steps.what: Review the pupil's current learning goals and agreed support approach
Assess the immediate learning challenge and select suitable encouragement
Encourage students to explore opportunities and persevere with challenging tasks
Observe engagement and adapt the next response to the pupil

tasks.design: Use a pinned current-goals view in {LMS} for the small existing support-plan lookup. The teacher retains assessment, personal encouragement and response monitoring; no encouragement log is created.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current support approach repeats navigation before some interactions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-pupil links can remove that navigation.
tasks.still_hard: The appropriate response changes with confidence, fatigue and the learning situation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when to encourage persistence and when to change the challenge.
tasks.altitude: Keep encouragement personal while simplifying actual context lookup.

reach.learn: Use the current support approach without ignoring the child's response

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and goal tracking, making a native context view plausible; local navigation savings remain E1.

assumptions: The lookup is existing occasional reference to a pupil's support plan, not a new requirement before every encouraging remark. No written outcome or motivation score is assumed.

The teacher verifies current goal and support-plan version in s1 and observes the immediate challenge and response in s2-s4. Those activities retain their full time except repeated navigation; missing links require manual lookup.
A native current-goals link removes 1 of 10 lookup hours; all 90 interaction and observation hours remain. Document templates do not replace that work.
The current view uses existing configuration and adds no periodic service or capture upkeep.
unknowns: Whether this context lookup is already one click
research_questions: Is there a real repeated goal-navigation operation before encouragement?

already_counted.description: Read and verify current learning context

incremental.description: Existing pinned view adds no recurring service

approvals.approved_version: Exact encouragement delivered to the current pupil for the current learning challenge; changed needs require teacher reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=99 with no upkeep gives 1 net. Already pinned goals retain all 10 lookup hours and yield zero. A partly effective link retaining 9.5 lookup hours plus other 90 yields 0.5 net; all responsive encouragement remains retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop individual educational plans through family and professional consultation

steps.what: Review assessment evidence and the current individual educational plan
Confer with parents and professionals about educational, physical and social development goals
Write individual educational goals, support arrangements and review dates in the plan
Check plan content and the exact version for permitted recipients
Send the checked plan version to parents and permitted professionals

tasks.design: Use linked assessment context and existing plan fields in {LMS}. Retain consultation and substantive goal writing, then check and separately send the final plan through the current {EMAIL} or record-system channel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teachers repeatedly find assessment context and reconstruct stable plan fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil and plan modules can preserve linked context and existing headings.
tasks.still_hard: Agreement on appropriate individual support cannot be inferred from records alone.
tasks.human_edge: Reconcile educational evidence with the family's experience.
tasks.altitude: Reduce plan assembly without delegating support decisions.

reach.learn: Trace each plan change to the actual consultation

evidence.claim: ParnasSys describes pupil records and an OPP module; native plan handling is supported, while this task's savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: The plan is the required educational artifact used by the family and support staff; no duplicate meeting summary is added.

The teacher verifies pupil identity, current plan version and assessment dates in s1, obtains support decisions in s2 and captures goals, arrangements and review dates in s3. Capture and reconciliation remain inside 24 retained writing hours; absent links require manual review.
Linked assessments remove 3 of 20 retrieval hours. Existing headings and reusable unchanged pupil context remove 6 of 30 writing hours; all new goals and support content stay human.
Ordinary author saves in s3 remain retained with no approval. The final recipient/version check in s4 exists for the separate external send.
unknowns: Compatibility of the current plan format
research_questions: Does native plan reuse reduce total work after individual rewriting and source reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Capture plan decisions and check the final sharing version

incremental.description: Maintain assessment links and plan layout

approvals.approved_version: Exact pupil information and proposals disclosed to verified consultation participants; participant or content changes require reconsideration
Exact final individual plan and permitted recipients checked in s4; edits or recipient changes invalidate the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=91, gross 9 less 1.5 upkeep gives 7.5 net. Incompatible legacy plans retaining all 20 retrieval and 28.5 writing hours have their saving offset by upkeep. Reusable plan structure retaining 18 retrieval and 25.5 writing hours plus other 50 and 1.5 upkeep yields 5 net. Consultation, final check and real send remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet families about progress, community resources and support skills

steps.what: Review the child's progress and permitted family disclosure
Check relevant community resources and current contact or eligibility information
Meet parents to discuss progress, explain resources and demonstrate relevant support skills
Write discussed concerns and agreed support in the existing pupil contact note

tasks.design: Use a native progress view in {LMS}, linked current resource references in {DOCS} and the existing contact-note headings. The teacher retains the family meeting and separately records actual concerns and agreed support.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress navigation, repeated directory searching and stable note context consume handling time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil views and direct resource links can reduce those specific operations.
tasks.still_hard: Family priorities, accessibility and the suitability of advice remain contextual.
tasks.human_edge: Explain progress respectfully and show support skills the family can use.
tasks.altitude: Reduce preparation and note repetition around family support.

reach.learn: Verify availability rather than treat a directory entry as a service guarantee

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and parent communication; native preparation and contact-note reuse remain task-specific E1 estimates.

assumptions: The current pupil contact note supports subsequent teaching and family contact. No new transcript, family letter or referral send is added.

The teacher verifies progress dates and disclosure permission in s1, current directory contacts and stated eligibility in s2, and captures the meeting's actual concerns and agreements in s4. All verification and capture are priced; stale resource entries require manual checking.

A pupil progress view removes 3 of 15 retrieval hours; direct resource links remove 2 of 10 directory-navigation hours but no eligibility judgement. Stable contact headings remove 2 of 20 writing hours.
The teacher does not automatically refer the family or send a resource packet. Ordinary author saves remain retained without approval.
research_questions: Do direct links and current pupil context reduce preparation after checking resource freshness?

already_counted.description: Capture and check substantive family-contact content

incremental.description: Maintain resource links and contact-note layout

approvals.approved_version: Exact pupil progress, resource explanation and support demonstration delivered to the verified permitted parent or guardian; changed disclosure or recipient requires reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=93, gross 7 less 1 upkeep gives 6 net. Stale directory links and unavailable progress metadata retain all 25 preparation hours and 19 note hours, offsetting the one hour removed with upkeep. Usable links retaining 13 progress, 9 resource and 18 note hours plus 55 meeting and 1 upkeep yield 4 net. The meeting and suitability judgement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor staff adherence to special education requirements

steps.what: Review applicable special education requirements and current pupil support arrangements
Monitor teachers and assistants delivering the special education program
Determine whether observed practice meets requirements or needs corrective support
Discuss observed practice and required support with the relevant staff member
Write significant findings and agreed support in the existing monitoring note

tasks.design: Use direct requirement references in {DOCS} and current support context in {LMS}. Retain observation, adherence judgement and staff discussion, with significant findings written separately in the existing monitoring note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated requirement navigation and note headings consume a small monitoring share.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and existing note structure remove those repeated actions.
tasks.still_hard: Compliance depends on actual practice and appropriate individual adaptation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a justified adaptation from a missed requirement and coach staff appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Make monitoring evidence clearer without automated staff judgement.

reach.learn: Separate observed evidence from conclusions about staff performance

evidence.claim: Direct requirements references and existing monitoring-note headings can reduce repeated handling without assessing staff automatically.

assumptions: The monitoring note already records significant findings and agreed support for subsequent follow-up by the teacher or coordinator. No routine log of every staff interaction is created.

The teacher verifies requirement version and support arrangement in s1, gathers actual observations in s2, judges adherence in s3 and captures findings in s5. Capture is included in 9 retained writing hours; missing references require manual verification.
Direct links remove 3 of 15 reference-navigation hours. Stable monitoring headings remove 1 of 10 note-writing hours. Observation, decision and feedback remain fully retained.
No automated adherence flag, staff score, alert or escalation send is implied. Ordinary author saves retain their time without self-approval.
unknowns: Whether current monitoring notes already have stable headings
research_questions: Do requirement links and existing note headings reduce actual repeated monitoring work?

already_counted.description: Capture significant findings and agreed support

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=96, gross 4 less 0.5 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Already direct requirement references retaining all lookup and 9.5 note hours have the half-hour saving offset by upkeep. A usable reference index retaining 13 lookup and 9.5 note hours plus other 75 and 0.5 upkeep yields 2 net. Observation, adherence judgement and staff discussion remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain individual support, family relationships and professional oversight while reducing real plan and note repetition.
reach: Connect family consultation with usable support plans
Use observed evidence to coach staff
skills_to_grow: Use current pupil and requirement views
Separate direct interactions from records used for follow-up
role.ambitious_version: A teacher with reliable support context and clear plans who personally encourages pupils, collaborates with families and oversees practice.
